chapter.title: What Are Design Patterns? Why Use Them?

payload.markdown: How many times have you reached a stage in a project and found that there is no going forward? Chances are you must backtrack some way before starting out again.

payload.markdown: By defining common problems, patterns can help you to improve your design. Sometimes, the first step to a solution is recognizing that you have a problem.

blocks.text: By defining common problems, patterns can help you to improve your design. Sometimes, the first step to a solution is recognizing that you have a problem.

items: Behavioral Patterns: Patterns that distribute responsibility and coordinate behaviour.
Creational Patterns: Patterns that control how objects come into being.
Design Principles: Guidelines such as SOLID that keep object designs flexible.
Enterprise Patterns: Patterns for service layers, domain objects and application architecture.
Error Patterns: Repeatable strategies: fail fast, wrap and rethrow, aggregate and report.
Factory Pattern: Creating objects through a dedicated creator instead of new at every call site.
Pattern Principles: What design patterns are, how to describe them, and when one fits.
Persistence Patterns: Patterns that map objects to storage: data mapper, identity map, unit of work.
